contract.task_clause:
Defendant is on trial. Which of the following, if occurs, would NOT cause a due process violation in the trial?
Option A: The trial is conducted in a way that jurors would not be able to give evidence reasonable consideration.
Option B: The defendant is compelled to stand trial in street clothing.
Option C: The defendant is compelled to stand trial or appear at penalty phase proceedings visibly shackled (unless there are security concerns).
Option D: Jurors are exposed to influence favorable to the prosecution.
